about: Declared before any operator was run. Graders are computed by the twin (replay), never by a model.

episode.note: reset = step 0. Step 1 = commissioning (the healthy per-cell configuration: none on the visible tier, seeded offsets on the masked tier). Step 2 = the fault. The operator then gets exactly 3 applies (steps 3-5); None or [] is a no-op step that still advances. Everyone is graded at step 5, so pairs are on the same UE positions.

reference: healthy counterfactual at the grade step: same scenario, seed and preset, no fault, no-op steps (on the stationary viavi-like preset this equals the pre-fault state; on the mobile official preset UEs move, so the same-step healthy state is the fair pre-fault level)

tolerance.note: success = every graded KPI at the grade step >= healthy - tolerance. 0.02 is just above one UE on the 60-UE preset (1/60 = 0.0167). sinr_p10_db is the pooled-p10 mixture estimate from twin.kpis on both sides.

material_gap.note: a KPI counts towards recovery only if the fault opened a gap (healthy - unfixed) of at least this much at the grade step

recovery: per KPI: (final - unfixed) / (healthy - unfixed) at the grade step, clipped to [-1, 1]; recovery = mean over the material KPIs. unfixed = the faulted twin with 3 no-op steps.
incident_inclusion: a candidate incident is kept only if no_action fails the success check on it (some graded KPI gap > tolerance) and the fault apply was not clipped by the SDK safety filter
also_reported: wrong_cell_actions (applied items on a cell the fault did not touch)
clamped (any SDK safety-filter rule fired on an operator step) and the rule ids

bootstrap.method: paired by item_id, percentile interval of the mean difference

gain_counts_if: ci_low > 0 (the interval excludes zero) and the declared target is met

no_action.why: sanity line: doing nothing closes no gap by construction

rule_baseline.why: the SDK rule controller should beat doing nothing

config_revert.why: the simple heuristic (revert the odd cell out to the median configuration) should beat doing nothing

ppo.why: a learned policy should beat doing nothing

oracle.why: best-of-K with replay look-ahead is the upper bound; if it cannot close 80% the suite is too hard

swarm.why: PRIMARY (the pass line): paired recovery gain of swarm over config_revert on the MASKED tier of the test split, lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0. Declared after the offline baselines (config_revert masked mean 0.467) and before any swarm run.
secondary_reported_not_pass_line: success rate on the masked tier
wrong-cell actions on the masked tier <= rule_baseline's on the same incidents

metric_names.gain_ci_low_vs_no_action: lower end of the 95% paired bootstrap interval of mean(recovery - no_action recovery)
metric_names.gain_ci_low_vs_config_revert_masked: lower end of the 95% paired bootstrap interval of mean(swarm recovery - config_revert recovery) over the masked-tier test incidents
